name: task-management
description: Takes over Claude Code's task system. Native TaskCreate/TaskUpdate calls, approved plans, decisions and commits are mirrored into a git-tracked markdown store at .bytedesk/task-management/ — epics, tasks, ADRs, acceptance criteria, evidence. One store per project, shared by every git worktree, with claims, WIP limits and gates that keep sessions honest. Includes worktree management with shared node_modules, an MCP server, and a live dashboard.
